messages:
Maya Chen: Standup — yesterday finished the canary config for route-policy-gw-tilt-v3. Saw ~2% 429 increase in staging after warmup. Blocker: need infra to bump token-bucket on staging. Today: opening PR for canary rollout and will pair with @AJ on auth header edge-case.

AJ: on it, can bump the bucket. what's the exact policy id?

Maya Chen: policy id: route-policy-gw-tilt-v3. Log sample:
```
[2024-09-15T14:02:31Z] 429 throttle POST /v1/infer client=svc-frontend burst=1200 qps=70
```
Also saw retries from SDK piling up.

Tess Park: tl;dr — looks like KV cache coldstart causing short spike; can we throttle client retries? low-effort SDK tweak: `retry_backoff=200ms`.

Kai: I can try a lightweight rate tweak on staging: reduce burst to 200 and raise steady qps to 80, run smoke tests after.

Maya Chen: thanks — AJ once you bump token bucket, Kai please watch p50/p95 latency. pinging @Riya for CR: PR #4321 needs review.

Riya: I’ll review this morning, leaving comments on the canary rollout doc. Quick Q: is fallback to a smaller model enabled for this route?

Maya Chen: yes fallback is enabled (smaller-llm-v1), but want to avoid hitting it. planning an experiment to route by token length.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for route-policy-gw-tilt-v3 on staging — id dc-1873 — 6/10 hosts updated.

Kai: smoke passed on 3 hosts, no 429s after throttling. will monitor for 30m.

AJ: token bucket updated on staging `policy=route-policy-gw-tilt-v3` burst=500->200 qps=50->80. ping me if you need rollback.

Maya Chen: Great, blocker cleared. Next: I'll add a metric alert for 429 spikes and a short runbook section. Done for today, thanks team :thumbsup:
